Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Production transparent RGBA VFX animation sprite atlas for the original hand-painted dark fantasy side-scroller 秘境决斗. This is a brand-new STAR hero F/E/R atlas, not an icon sheet.
Primary request: Paint exactly TWENTY-FOUR separate consecutive animation phases, exactly FOUR columns by SIX rows, portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Each invisible cell is 256x256. Read left to right, then next row. F occupies first two rows (frames 0-7); E third/fourth rows; R fifth/sixth rows. No labels or visible grid.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere except the individual effect; isolated cutout particles, clean transparent gutters at least 16px around EVERY cell, absolutely no shared haze or glow connecting neighboring cells. No opaque color backdrop.
Style: luxurious detailed hand-painted dark fantasy game VFX, rich sapphire/indigo stardust, luminous pale-blue cores, fine warm antique-gold astrolabe rings, crisp engraved celestial details. Match the project's previous blue-gold star magic materials, but animation must have distinct evolving structure and coherent motion rather than eight brightness variants. High clarity at small game scale, controlled bloom with transparent feathered edges, no full-screen flash.
Stability: each cell local center x128. Keep stable common scale and camera with complete silhouettes inside x18..238, y18..238. F is horizontal and oriented RIGHT along the x-axis, with center/flight anchor (128,128) in all eight frames, so the renderer can rotate it. E is centered at (128,128), same scale across frames. R is side-view elliptical GROUND magic centered x128 with ground-contact line y208 and no scenery.
F NEW DESIGN, single concentrated star-core lance, absolutely NEVER three projectiles or fan spread. Frames 0..7 in first two rows: 0 thin rings fold inward to gather one compact star nucleus; 1 rings squeeze a single bright nucleus and draw a short LEFT tail; 2 one dense pointed star core jets RIGHT with a coherent blue-gold stream trailing LEFT; 3 the same one core continues forward faster, long curving fine starstream left, change its internal star spokes; 4 on impact the same central nucleus visibly collapses inward into a tiny dark-blue gravity point, inward-curving gold arclets sucked toward center, rightward momentum still readable; 5 the implosion releases one expanding annular ring of star fragments and short radial shock spokes, still horizontally aligned; 6 hollow broken ring expands and twists with sparse sapphire fragments; 7 a few thin curling arclets and residual blue-gold particles drift outward. No extra star nuclei in flight.
E Star Rewind healing/protection, eight consecutive phases third/fourth rows: 0 sparse broken orbital arc curling inward; 1 counterclockwise double orbits form around tiny hourglass; 2 engraved translucent blue-gold hourglass grows with stardust flowing UPWARD; 3 hourglass fills with reversed starlight while narrow protective orbital veil rises; 4 a clear shield-shaped curved veil wraps the hourglass, orbital ring rotated; 5 reverse-flow stardust transfers into a coherent broad healing halo; 6 hourglass dissolves into unwinding rings; 7 delicate broken orbital traces and a few falling stars. No character inside the shield. Keep rich physical sapphire/gold materials and distinct temporal phases.
R Starsea Judgement, eight consecutive phases last two rows, ground contact at y208 always: 0 very thin ellipse of gold zodiac-like pictorial marks (NOT writing) and blue dust; 1 spiral star sea gathers on the same floor ellipse; 2 three slender VERTICAL star beams start rising, with central brightest; 3 five staggered vertical shafts extend upward with star caps and winding rings; 4 central shaft strikes the floor with two side shafts and pronounced horizontal starsea swirl; 5 side shafts strike at different offsets while center fragments upward, five beam rhythm; 6 shafts withdraw into the SAME ground circle, ring breaks into ascending shards; 7 sparse fading fragments above thin remaining ellipse. All vertical beams fully inside cell, no cropped tops.
Constraints: all 24 frames distinct and purposeful, no repeated/copied frame, same materials and stable anchors, no scene, ground platform, person, body, face, weapon wielder, UI, title, letters, words, numerals, panel border, watermark, black rectangle, contact sheet background, painted checkerboard. Do not divide cells with lines. This must be a genuine transparent sprite sheet with enough detail for final game art.
